## Details

### elekloader

Mod loader: user supplies the stock OS file, the tool builds the custom .syx locally. Also covers Octatrack and (proof of concept) Analog Four MKII, which are out of scope for now. Canonical repo is unclear: the forum post also embeds github.com/elekloader/elekloader (web app at elekloader.github.io/elekloader); forks exist (AvroraPolnareff, naturarum, toonst). Forum: builder issue reported 2026-10-19. Licence GPL-2.0-or-later.

_Sources: forum thread 30, GitHub release v0.4.0, gearnews, dubspot_

### Modwerk (formerly Octamod)

Browser-based hub, builds locally from the user's own stock OS. Browse mods by device, forum with a section per device, shared SDK. Dubspot (13 Oct): several modules are still early prototypes. last_activity = date of the Dubspot article, not a forum post.

_Sources: gearnews, dubspot, forum thread 36_

### elektron-firmware-tool

C, MIT licence. Unpacks Elektron .syx firmware and repacks it as a valid file. Lists Analog Heat MKI, MKII and +FX among supported devices - currently the only Analog Heat-relevant tool we found. Forum listing: 113 stars, repo created 2026-07-22, "last commit 1 month ago" at the time of listing.

_Sources: forum mod list (mods.php?id=7), forum thread 8_

### digiemu

Emulator for testing mods without hardware. GitHub description also lists Model:Cycles and Model:Samples. A Mac release is mentioned in the thread but no link was given. A user reported an audio issue.

_Sources: forum thread 20_

### RingTone (master ring mod / wavefold / EQ)

Master effects with a DIGI FX page. Tested on hardware and in digiemu. Open items per author: encoder acceleration, saving state at pattern level. Built with elekloader.

_Sources: GitHub release 2.0o_

### Request: additional sequencer pages for DN1/DT1
